title: Builder Signals · 2026-06-23
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 27 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 10 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Codex lead Thibault Sottiaux spent the week doing something refreshingly practical: openly crowdsourcing product feedback. He asked "What should we improve in the Codex app — what's not delightful?" and floated a light discussion on bankable usage resets ("Are you a hoarder, or do you use them without breaking a sweat?"). The high engagement (2K+ on each) signals Codex is in an intense UX-polishing phase, going head-to-head with Claude Code. The takeaway for enterprise selection: coding-agent *experience* differen…
featured.insightZh: Codex 团队负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 这周连发数条做了一件很务实的事：直接向用户征集产品反馈。他问"Codex app 里有什么不够'惊艳'、该改进的地方？"，又抛出一个关于"用量重置（usage resets）可以攒着用了——你是囤积派还是用着不眨眼派？"的轻量讨论。这种公开收集真实使用痛点的姿态，配合数千的互动量，说明 Codex 正处在快速打磨产品体验、跟 Claude Code 贴身竞争的阶段。对企业选型的启示：编程 agent 的体验差异化（而非单纯模型能力）正成为新战场。

featured.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
featured.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch had a sharp line this week: "Coding agents will squeeze every ounce of IKEA effect out of you, if you let them" — a nod to how humans overvalue what they help build, and how agents keep nudging you to invest more so you can't let go. He paired it with a showcase of his team's obsessive performance work (WebGPU shaders, layout, blocking scripts, scrutinized frame by frame). The juxtaposition is telling: clear-eyed about agent-collaboration psychology, yet still insisting on human-gated qu…
featured.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 这周有一句很犀利的观察："编程 agent 会榨干你身上每一分'宜家效应'（IKEA effect），只要你允许它。"——意思是人类会因为亲手参与而高估自己产出的价值，而 agent 会不断诱导你投入更多、从而更舍不得放手。他同时晒了 Vercel 团队在性能上的极致打磨（WebGPU shader、布局、阻塞脚本逐帧抠优化）。这两条放一起很有意思：一边是对 agent 协作心理的清醒认知，一边是仍然坚持人工把关质量的工程态度。

featured.title: Google DeepMind 的 Logan Kilpatrick：为什么"模型会吃掉 harness"
featured.summaryEn: The agent harness everyone is scrambling to build today will, within twelve months, be "eaten" by the model itself — digested and upstreamed into native capability, with the real alpha moving elsewhere. The "model" hasn't been just weights for a while; it's an entire sprawling system grown around them. Logan Kilpatrick runs Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, making him a key figure for Google's developer ecosystem. The conversation centers on one thesis — "the model eats the harness." His logic: two years ago an LLM was a set of weights, tokens in, tokens out. Today we still call it "the model," still call it Gemini 3.5 / GPT / Claude, but it's actually a vast system built around the weights — agentic tool-calling, hosted search/code-execution, containerized runs, the agent harness, all baked in. His sharp call: everyone now says "we must build our own harness, the alpha is in the har…
featured.insightZh: 今天大家拼命自建的 agent harness（脚手架），十二个月内会被模型本身"吃掉"、内化成原生能力——真正的 alpha 会转移到别处；"模型"早已不只是权重，而是一整套围绕权重生长的系统。 Logan Kilpatrick 执掌 Google AI Studio 和 Gemini API，是 Google 面向开发者生态的关键人物。这期对话围绕一个核心论断展开——"模型会吃掉 harness（the model eats the harness）"。他的逻辑是：两年前 LLM 就是一组权重，token 进、token 出；但今天我们嘴上还叫它"模型"、还叫 Gemini 3.5 / GPT / Claude，实质上它已经是一整套围绕权重生长的庞大系统——agentic 工具调用、托管的搜索/代码执行、容器化运行、agent harness 全都长在里面。 他的判断很尖锐：现在所有人都在喊"得自建 harness，alpha 在 harness 里"，但这套今天理解的 harness，十二个月内很可能不成立——模型会把这些脚手架消化掉、上游内化成原生能力，alpha 会转移到别处。对企业的直接含义：不要把核心竞争力押在"自己搭的 harness/路由层"上，那是会被模型迭代抹平的临时优势。 Logan 还谈到 Google 的"贯穿线（through line）"战略转变：过去 Gemini（模型）是连接 50+ 个 Google 产品的贯穿线，现在这条线正升级为 Antigravity——一个 agent harness 生态（IDE / Web / CLI / SDK），同一套 harness 驱动 Search、Gemini app、Cloud、AI Studio。关于"蚕食自身业务"的担忧，他借 Sundar 的观察反驳：AI 当初被认为会冲击搜索，结果反而让搜索量大增、是正和而非负和——"Google 的成功不是最大化用户盯着产品的时间，而是最大化客户达成目标"。其他亮点：world model 的定义正在模糊（Omni 是单一全能模型而非多模型路由）…

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie made a call enterprises should heed: "Agents will use software 100X more than people. When that happens, there's a huge need for guardrails on what agents are doing — so they don't leak data or change the wrong information." He also flagged Sakana's new mixture-of-models architecture (one API, work farmed out across multiple models). Levie's core message: once agents become the primary users of software, the security/permissions/audit layer becomes non-negotiable — exactly the part of enterpris…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 抛出一个对企业很关键的判断："Agent 使用软件的频率会是人类的 100 倍。当这发生时，对'护栏（guardrails）'的需求会爆炸——要防止 agent 泄露数据、改错信息、越权操作。"他还点评了 Sakana 新发布的"模型混合"架构（单一 API 背后由多个模型分工协作）。Levie 的核心信息是：当 agent 成为软件的主要使用者，安全、权限、审计这套基础设施会变成刚需——这正是企业 AI 落地绕不开的一环。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC President Garry Tan highlighted an underrated trend: "Looking back, one underestimated thing will be how useful it is to have your own personal brain and company brain in 2026 at the dawn of usable AGI. AGI gives you the intelligence — you supply the context." He built and open-sourced GBrain for this. The enterprise lesson is direct: model capability gets commoditized; the real moat is whether you can systematically feed your org's private knowledge and context to the AI — "context, not prompt."
items.insightZh: YC 总裁 Garry Tan 这周谈了一个被低估的趋势："2026 年、在可用 AGI 的黎明，拥有你自己的'个人大脑'和'公司大脑'有多大用——这一点回头看会发现被严重低估了。AGI 给你智能，但你需要给它喂上下文。"他为此做了 GBrain 并开源。对企业的启示很直接：模型能力会被商品化，真正的差异化护城河在于你能不能把组织的私域知识、上下文系统化地喂给 AI——"context, not prompt"。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者（15 万+ 读者）
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang shared a counterintuitive technical insight from @liu8in: "We've been trying to build a video agent. We learned the hard way that agents have no visual intelligence." The surprising upshot — HTML turned out to be the foundation for agentic video-making, because agents excel at structured text/code, so decomposing video into HTML-like programmable structure beats asking them to "see" it directly. Peter also reflected on how his immigrant-bred scarcity mindset has become a liability i…
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 这周分享了一个反直觉的技术观察，来自 @liu8in："我们一直想做视频 agent，但吃了大亏才明白——agent 没有视觉智能。结果 HTML 反而成了 agentic 视频制作的基础。"因为 agent 擅长处理结构化文本/代码，把视频拆解成 HTML 式的可编程结构，比让它直接"看"视频要靠谱得多。Peter 还反思了自己作为移民养成的"稀缺心态"在 token 无限套餐时代反而成了包袱。

items.title: Nan Yu · Linear 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: Linear's head of product Nan Yu weighed in on quality this week, endorsing the framing: "'Quality is irrational' is a great way to describe it. You have to have an irrational level of commitment to constantly choose quality, and an irrational level of self-belief that controlling the details actually makes a difference." In an era where AI can mass-produce "good enough" output, it's a weighty reminder: the willingness to invest irrationally in quality is precisely where people and products differentiate.
items.insightZh: Linear 产品负责人 Nan Yu 这周聊了"质量"这件事，引用并认同了一句话："'质量是非理性的（Quality is irrational）'是个很贴切的描述。你必须有一种非理性的承诺去持续选择质量，还要有一种非理性的自信去相信——把细节控制好真的会带来不同。"在 AI 能批量生产"够用"内容的当下，这是一个很有分量的提醒：愿意为质量付出非理性投入，恰恰是人和产品的差异化所在。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 社区（ClawFather）
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger (known in the OpenClaw circle as "ClawFather") responded to community chatter about OpenClaw this week: "The hype died down. We improved quality, grew a team, and created a non-profit — whereas competitors are VC-funded with other agendas." He also noted he'd been skeptical about multi-model routing, but "seems my hunch was right." Set against the builder community's intense recent debate on model routing and agent harnesses, it reflects an emerging consensus: the window for winning purely on rou…
items.insightZh: Peter Steinberger（OpenClaw 圈内人称 ClawFather）这周回应了关于 OpenClaw 的社区讨论："炒作热度降下来了。我们提升了质量、组建了团队，还成立了非营利组织——而竞品是 VC 投资、各有别的算盘。"他还提到自己对"多模型路由"原本持怀疑态度，但看下来"我的直觉是对的"。结合最近 builder 圈对模型路由、agent harness 的密集讨论，这反映出一个共识正在形成：纯靠路由/harness 取巧的窗口在收窄。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder（本简报源作者）
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang — author of the data source behind this digest — shared a practical rule of thumb for preventing AI slop: "Is your input (the context) longer than the output? I've found that for AI to produce quality results, my input is often 3x the output." She clarified: "I'm talking about context, not prompt." It rhymes with Garry Tan's "context, not prompt" theme: in 2026, feeding the model abundant, high-quality context matters more than wordsmithing the prompt.
items.insightZh: 本简报数据源的作者 Zara Zhang 这周给了一条防 AI 垃圾内容（AI slop）的实用准则："一个好的经验法则：你的输入（上下文）是否比输出更长？我发现要让 AI 产出高质量结果，我的输入常常是输出的 3 倍。"她还补了一句澄清——"我说的是 context，不是 prompt"。这和 Garry Tan 的"context, not prompt"形成呼应：在 2026 年，喂给模型足量、高质量的上下文，比雕琢提示词更决定产出质量。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人
items.summaryEn: Cursor's design lead Ryo Lu showed off a personal project that captures the power of vibe coding: missing wooden shelves, he built a "Books" app inside his own ryOS — works with any epub, syncs reading progress with the account. The process: "started in Cursor mobile, then hand-tuned the animations and textures until things felt right." A great template: a pro designer uses AI coding tools to rough out the skeleton, then applies human taste for the last-mile polish — AI for speed, human for quality.
items.insightZh: Cursor 设计负责人 Ryo Lu 这周展示了一个很能体现"vibe coding"威力的个人项目：他怀念木质书架，于是在自己的 ryOS 系统里做了一个"Books"应用——支持任意 epub、跟账号同步阅读进度。整个过程"先在 Cursor 移动端起手，然后手工调动画和材质纹理直到手感对了"。这是一个很好的样本：专业设计师用 AI 编程工具快速搭出骨架，再用人工审美做最后一公里的精修——AI 提速、人定质量。
